name: Direct Manipulation Widgets for Multidimensional TF
aliases: Direct Manipulation Widgets for Transfer Functions
Dual-Domain Interaction with Transfer Function Widgets
definition: A suite of interaction tools to bridge the conceptual gap between the spatial domain (3D geometry/data) and the abstract transfer-function domain, allowing simultaneous interaction in both.
summary: Direct Manipulation Widgets for Multidimensional TF are interactive tools that let users intuitively specify transfer functions by probing 3D geometry, linking spatial queries directly to visual feedback.
